MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 19
   C. 13
   D. 7

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 22
   C. 55
   D. 32

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 13

5. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 7

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

8. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 18
   D. 6

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

10. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

13. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 1

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

17. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

18. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 3

19. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

20. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

21. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 40

24. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

25. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

26. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

27. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

28. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

29. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

30. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 23

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
